body.message: Today,  1st August , is the guest's check-in date, and they are expected to arrive at  12:00 PM . Therefore, it will not be possible to arrange a viewing today, as the apartment needs to be prepared for the guest's arrival. Additionally, your requested viewing time is in the afternoon. As previously communicated to the guest, we had already committed to providing them with an early check-in. For this reason, we are unable to accommodate a viewing before their arrival. Thank you for your understanding. Kind regards, Chahana T. fäm Living
